title: 陆克文：印度AI行业有真正马力，未来五年增长故事？
speaker: Kevin Rudd

segments.en: The point for optimism in India having spent most of last week here in Delhi before I went to Beijing and now I'm back in Delhi. That's what we think tankers do.
segments.zh: 对印度乐观的一点是，上周大部分时间我都在德里，然后去了北京，现在又回到德里。这就是我们智库人士的工作。

segments.en: Is the emerging AI sector here in India I think has some genuine horsepower. And speaking to venture capitalists here in Delhi and in Mumbai, what's with pumping with the unvolving frontier with India's own development of its own frontier models?
segments.zh: 是印度这里新兴的AI行业，我认为有一些真正的马力。与德里和孟买的风险投资家交谈，他们正积极推动印度自己开发前沿模型。

segments.en: It applies to add five years to this, given the enormous technical base which exists within the Indian people writ large and the Indian diaspora more broad broadly.
segments.zh: 如果在此基础上再加五年，鉴于印度人民和更广泛的印度侨民中存在的巨大技术基础。

segments.en: Watch the AI stack unfold in India as the untold growth story of the next five years. Dr. Rudd is great to have you.
segments.zh: 关注印度AI栈的展开，这将是未来五年不为人知的增长故事。陆克文博士，很高兴邀请到你。
